title: Risks Associated with Buying Health Products Sold Online
what_it_is: Risks Associated with Buying Health Products Sold Online

sections.label: HSA public education on online health products
sections.summary: HSA regularly educates the public on risks of buying health products from dubious sources, including a six-week online campaign last year.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Mr Amrin Amin) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: The Health Sciences Authority (HSA) regularly educates the public on the risks of buying health products from dubious or unknown sources, including online purchases.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Mr Amrin Amin) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: For example, last year, HSA ran a six-week online campaign to educate consumers on such dangers.

sections.label: HSA school and student education efforts
sections.summary: HSA works with HPB and MOE on school programmes and with tertiary students to warn peers about buying health products online.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Mr Amrin Amin) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: HSA has worked with the Health Promotion Board (HPB) to include the risks of purchasing health products online in HPB's school-based educational programmes.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Mr Amrin Amin) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: HSA has also collaborated directly with tertiary students from the local polytechnics and universities to reach out to their peers about the dangers of buying health products online.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Mr Amrin Amin) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: HSA will continue to work with HPB and the Ministry of Education to educate school students on the risks associated with buying health products from dubious online sites and the need for discernment when purchasing health products.
